from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document for cause-of-action sorting."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad case type identified in the document (e.g., 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Criminal')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or legal category identified in the document, if any")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_documents: list[CaseDocument]
